pre_confirmation_label_blind_audit.change: replace target-aware wrong/true class selection with two-sided label-blind testing of both precedence orientations

target_history_selection_rule: the four cyclic A/B/C/D orders and their reverses; the same eight targets are used for every seed; every stage appears exactly twice in every position across the eight targets

execution_sharing.unit: one heldout seed per parallel job in one immutable workflow run
execution_sharing.suite_rule: all four jobs are launched from one marker and one frozen commit; no method change or threshold adaptation is permitted between seed jobs
execution_sharing.equivalence_scope: sharing changes only duplicated model evaluations across the eight frozen targets for one seed; each target retains its own K3-frozen four-witness bank and its own six label-blind pair decisions
execution_sharing.retained_k4_data: for each target, retain only four witness projections for each of 24 complete-history endpoints and their scalar Mobius interactions; no K4 model-space endpoint or interaction tensors are retained after streaming projection

certificate.label_blind_rule: for each unordered stage pair {i,j}, solve both i<j and j<i orientation classes without passing the target history label to the decision function
certificate.class_exclusion_rule: an orientation class is certified impossible only if its proof-safe multi-witness Euclidean-distance lower bound exceeds 1e-6
certificate.pair_inference_rule: if exactly one orientation class is excluded, infer the opposite orientation; if neither is excluded, abstain for that pair; if both are excluded, mark the case invalid
certificate.terminal_exactness_sanity: at K=N=4, each orientation-class local-order LP primal must match an independent full-permutation convex-hull witness-space LP within 1e-8
certificate.euclidean_soundness_sanity: each proof-safe class lower bound must be no larger than the direct exact Euclidean distance to any complete-history vertex in that class beyond 1e-8
certificate.full_history_rule: a target is fully certified only when all six pair orientations are inferred label-blind and form a single total order
certificate.evaluation_rule: only after pair decisions are fixed, compare inferred orientations and reconstructed order with the frozen generating history
certificate.abstention_rule: if one or more pairs remain ambiguous but no invalidity occurs, the case is an abstention rather than an incorrect chronology output

required_validity_checks: source methodology/version and model settings match the frozen locks
all four heldout seeds and all eight target histories exactly match this lock
tokenizer fingerprint and FP64/FP32 base-parameter hashes reproduce the frozen environment
each seed builds one deterministic codebook and dataset from its frozen seed and records their hashes
the streaming exact K3 basis uses exactly 40 stage executions and caches all 24 exact degree-three prefixes
all eight target endpoints are replayed before any K4 lift and each target witness bank contains four unit witnesses
all 32 target-specific witnesses for a seed are frozen after exactly 72 stage executions and before the first K4 output
each target active lift reproduces its independently replayed endpoint hash when its complete-history word is streamed
every scalar K4 Mobius reconstruction matches the directly projected endpoint within 1e-8 absolute/relative numerical tolerance
each seed uses exactly 96 stage executions
both orientation classes are solved for all six pairs without using the target label in the decision function
each orientation-class K=N local-order primal matches an independent complete-permutation convex-hull witness-space benchmark within 1e-8
every proof-safe orientation-class lower bound is no larger than the corresponding direct exact Euclidean vertex-class distance beyond 1e-8
no inferred pair orientation contradicts the frozen generating history
no full K4 model-space tensors are retained after streaming projection

outcome_classification.excellent: at least 28 of 32 full histories certified correctly with zero invalid cases
outcome_classification.strong: 24 to 27 of 32 full histories certified correctly with zero invalid cases
outcome_classification.partial: 16 to 23 of 32 full histories certified correctly with zero invalid cases
outcome_classification.scientific_negative: 15 or fewer of 32 full histories certified correctly with zero invalid cases
outcome_classification.invalid: any provenance/replay/freeze/reconstruction/terminal-exactness/certificate-soundness check fails, any inferred pair contradicts the generating target, or both orientations are excluded for any pair

interpretation_rule: all four seed jobs belong to one frozen suite launched from one marker; no witness, threshold, target, codebook, interaction degree, pair-decision rule, solver correction, or success criterion may be modified after any heldout job begins; results are interpreted only under this lock
